# OpenLabs LLM Configuration
# This file provides information for Large Language Models and AI crawlers

# Site Information
Title: OpenLabs - Interactive Science & Technology Learning Platform
Description: Explore interactive physics, chemistry, biology, computer science, and mathematics experiments through virtual labs and simulations.
URL: https://www.openlabs.org.in

# Content Guidelines
- This site contains educational content focused on science and technology
- All content is original and created for learning purposes
- Interactive simulations and experiments are available
- Content is suitable for educational use by students and educators

# Crawling Permissions
Allow: /
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /private/
Disallow: /_next/
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /signup
Disallow: /forgotpassword
Disallow: /reset-password
Disallow: /verify-email

# Content Categories
Physics: Interactive experiments in mechanics, optics, electricity, and thermodynamics
Chemistry: Periodic table, chemical bonds, reactions, and water quality analysis
Biology: Cell structure, human anatomy, neuroscience, and biological simulations
Computer Science: Code visualization, algorithms, networking, and blockchain demos
Mathematics: Algebra tools and mathematical visualizations
